body: Founder: 'add github workload for WEAKNIGHT BEDROCK RACERS'. New .github/workflows/ci.yml, based on REDGARDEN's sibling ci.yml template but scoped down to what's actually real here (Phase 0 only -- no packaging/Windows cross-compile, since CLAUDE.md/NORTHSTAR.md don't claim a distributable build exists yet). Verified both compile commands locally before writing the workflow (gcc -std=c99, server + SDL2/GL client, both build clean with only pre-existing unused-function warnings in http_client.h). Commit 428256f used the newly-confirmed commit convention (type(scope): prefix in English, description in Traditional Chinese).
title: Add GitHub Actions CI workflow
